post_execution_authority_doctrine: A computation cannot authoritatively verify properties of its own not-yet-produced output. Claims about an execution's result must be evaluated by machinery running AFTER that execution has become immutable evidence. (Producer → evidence → verifier separation.)
attestation_acyclicity_doctrine: CORRECTION08: An attestation commit A8 cannot authoritatively verify itself. The cycle is broken by separating the immutable subject (C8) from the attestation commit (A8), and exposing only STATIC RELATIONS derivable from A8's tree. A8 attests C8 by reference, never claims A8 = PASS. If external verification of A8 is needed, layer signing/CI provenance/transparency log on top; do not recursively demand that A8 prove itself.
projection_identity_doctrine: A derived scalar is not actually derived if one authoritative projection still stores null, TBD, or a contradictory literal.
